name: 3Peak Incorporated Class A
summary: 3Peak Incorporated engages in the research and development, testing, and sale of integrated circuits, application systems, and software in China and internationally. The company also provides after-sales services. Its products include amplifiers and special function circuits, data converters, DCDC and battery management products, drivers, interfaces, isolation products, LDO and voltage references, power switches, and supervisors for use in automotive, communication, industrial, consumer electronics, medical health, and new energy applications. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Shanghai, China.
